column1: # The slowest recorded value of each wait that seeds a bound, by host class: the input that turns a class on.
# A bound is twice (the margin) its row's value. A class with no row for a measure seeds from twice the slowest
# row of any class (the lead's seed rule, 2026-11-07), then rises with its node's own; its own row, once its
# record is taken and added here, becomes its seed (no code change). A measure no class records is refused.
# Read at build time by hex_client::guest::shards (include_str!), which hex_runtime::guest re-exports.
# Windows-WHP rows: shards.exe a debug build, AWS-LC without assembly (AWS_LC_SYS_NO_ASM), as its records say.
